versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Upwork Proposal Generator skill.
- Automatically analyzes Upwork job posts (link or text) to identify requirements, needed skills, budget, and deadline.
- Generates a professional, original proposal (up to 300 words) including introduction, past work, unique fit, pricing, and timeline.
- Outputs proposals in a friendly, professional style tailored specifically to each job, avoiding template language.
- Supports simple installation via `npx clawhub@latest install upwork-proposal-generator`.
